fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Add one targeted oakridge-dbos test invocation covering run-config, observation mapping, and ordered publisher delivery; record its actual counts and output separately.
risks.description: The observation-only test run does not execute the direct T1 oakridge-dbos tests, weakening the required per-task test evidence.

risks.mitigation: Pin PR #791 head SHA db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef and fail the audit if the named branch no longer resolves to it.
risks.description: A branch-based detached checkout could inspect a later commit if the head branch moves after this analysis.

risks.mitigation: Keep the existing rule: publish the real failure and output with zero or unavailable counts as appropriate; never invent results.
risks.description: Database-backed observation tests may be unable to run in the builder environment.

body.summary: The audit is implementable with no blockers or ambiguous requirements. The verified PR #791 head is db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, and the target code contains both requested behaviors with focused tests. Two warning-level specification improvements would make the isolated verification deterministic and evidence-complete: pin the checkout to that PR head SHA, and run the direct oakridge-dbos tests for T1 in addition to the mandated observation suite.

findings.description: The mandated builder command `bun run --filter observation test` runs only the observation package (`package.json:7-11`, `observation/package.json:6-8`). Direct T1 coverage is outside that package: default-off and exact-choice parsing are tested in `oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83`, mapping is tested in `oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65`, and ordered/replayed delivery is tested in `oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-208`. As written, the only builder test output cannot provide task-specific execution evidence for T1.

PR #791 currently reports head `db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef`, base `epic/grade-pray`, and head branch `cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2`; the local origin ref currently matches. However, the specified checkout names only the branch ref, which can move independently of the immutable PR head after analysis. Pinning and validating the SHA would ensure the builder and assessor inspect the exact audited commit.

T1 matches concrete repository behavior at the verified head: `RunConfig` names `grading_enabled`, defaults an absent choice to false, rejects non-booleans, and retains the parsed value (`oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10`, `oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41`). Launch mapping carries the committed config beside the input and rejects malformed committed config (`oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:14-17`, `oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48`).

T2 matches concrete repository behavior at the verified head: settlement locks the execution row before rechecking the exact owner, attempt, status, and unexpired lease, then fences the authoritative write again (`observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:205-227`). Completion updates the execution, updates its provider attempt, and inserts the grade observation through one transaction callback (`observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292`); the worker passes the exact claim into completion (`observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95`).

Focused tests already express the requested T2 audit evidence: rollback on a refused observation append proves completion/observation atomicity (`observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244`), and expired, reclaimed, old-attempt, and lock-waiting claims are refused without writes (`observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357`). The specification rule to report an un-runnable test honestly is sufficient for environmental failures.

requirements.description: Produce at least three distinct analysis findings and the subsequent observation artifacts without feature work.
Define exactly one cohort named audit containing exactly tasks T1 and T2.
Audit T1: grading_enabled defaults off when absent and travels through ordered launch delivery.
Audit T2: evaluation settlement is fenced to the exact current claim and completion appends its observation atomically.
Builder performs a read-only detached inspection, runs the specified tests once, reports actual output/counts, and publishes the existing PR without repository or deployment mutations.
Assessor evaluates the builder exact head commit, provides at least one finding per task, cites path:start-end code evidence, and reports builder output separately as test_evidence.
No brief introduces another operator choice or confirmation.

source_spec_refs: Cohort topology: exactly one cohort named audit with tasks T1 and T2
T1 launch-config and ordered-delivery audit requirement
T2 exact-claim fencing and atomic completion audit requirement
Builder immutable-worktree, checkout, test, build_result, and existing-PR publication instructions
Assessor same-commit, per-task finding, code citation, and test_evidence instructions

proposed_spec_updates.change: After `bun run --filter observation test` once, also run once: `bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts`, and include its actual counts and output as separate T1 test evidence in build_result.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The currently mandated observation-package command does not execute the tests that directly verify T1 parsing, mapping, and ordered replay delivery.

proposed_spec_updates.change: State that the audited head of PR #791 is `db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef`; require the named origin branch to resolve to that SHA, check out that exact SHA detached, and require the assessor to assess the same SHA.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: This preserves the intended exact-commit audit even if the branch ref moves after specification review.
